scope: Admissions and career eligibility: source-backed follow-up to 24-program review

institutional_basic_skills.sat_act_role: Accepted as alternatives to demonstrate basic skills; not demonstrated as mandatory college entrance tests
institutional_basic_skills.blank_score_policy: Do not infer test-optional or test-blind from missing score averages
institutional_basic_skills.exemptions: May apply to qualifying graduates or degree holders; individual determination required

school_award.conditions: Completion and applicable basic skills requirements

limitations: School assertions of board approval not independently verified with board register
School-wide generic award does not prove exact printed program award title
No inferred CIP6 or CIP-SOC mapping
No current federal SAT/ACT mean imputed
